Sharing Educational Materials in Empirical Literary Studies

Tags: IGEL, cfp

Frank Hakemulder @Hakemulder #1 2025-06-02 05:42 UTC

We are exploring the idea of creating a shared repository of educational materials for BA and MA students in our field. The goal is to support teaching and learning by collecting and curating materials that are open access or shareable via a society’s portal . These may include resources on methodologies, research techniques, and core content areas of empirical literary studies and related fields. At the Aachen conference last year, we started the conversation about setting something like this up; now seems a good time to make an inventory of what the interest and potential contributions might be. Therefore, we’d greatly appreciate your input via this short questionnaire (approx. 5 minutes).

Here is the link to the survey.
